document.title: Honda Civic Type R (FL5) — diagnostic signal reference
document.subtitle: {dids} DIDs / {signals} signals read over OBD-II with UDS service 22: offsets, decoding, units, confidence and evidence.
intro: This reference was assembled from eight on-car capture sessions on one Honda Civic Type R (FL5, K20C1 2.0T, 6-speed manual) between 2026-09-08 and 2026-09-16, plus all the offline analysis that followed. Everything here came from **read-only diagnostics**. Nothing came from flashing, security access or memory reads.

It states what was observed **on that one car**, and labels every line with a confidence level. **High confidence does not mean independently calibrated, and it does not mean it holds on a stock car** — the car carries a Hondata FlashPro (unlocked and tuned ECU) and its market version was never confirmed. Verify before you rely on any of this on another vehicle.

facts.value: Honda Civic Type R **FL5**, K20C1 2.0T turbo, 6-speed manual
**Not confirmed** (privately imported). This document does not guess the model year and does not assume the software matches any one market's stock build.

Fitted with a Hondata FlashPro: **the ECU is unlocked and tuned**. Known consequence: on this car the default session reads every tested DID with no handshake at all — **that cannot be extrapolated to a stock car**.
Not compared. Part numbers for each module were read (see the module table); read yours with `22 F110` / `F112` / `F181` and compare.
2026-09-08 to 2026-09-16, eight on-car sessions; 105 logs entered the statistics, roughly 540,000 diagnostic transactions (277,000 positive responses).

scope: **The scope of every claim here is: this one car.** The public OBDb Honda-Civic signal set confirms that stock Civics answer `2610` / `2611`; the oil-temperature DID `268F` has **no external corroboration whatsoever** and is the highest-risk item in this document. The no-handshake behaviour was likewise only ever verified on this car.

Evidence in the other direction: several conclusions here agree with the public OBDb Civic entries (brake pressure, brake switch, fuel level, odometer, run time, knock, lambda), and two errors in that public archive were found in the process (see the refuted list).

layers.fact: OBD-II connector: pin 6 CAN-H, pin 14 CAN-L, pin 4 GND, pin 16 permanent 12 V. **Count 6 / 14 from the orientation of the male plug going into the car** — counting from the wrong side yields zero frames.
Classical CAN 2.0B, 500 kbit/s, ≤8 data bytes per frame, **no CAN FD** (12 logs, ~1.9 M frames, FD frame count 0). This only characterises the OBD side of the gateway.

29-bit ISO 15765 physical addressing: request `18DA<target>F1`, response `18DAF1<target>`; the tester address is fixed at `F1`. Functional broadcast `18DB33F1` enumerates the car. Mode 01 on 11-bit `7DF` / `7E0` draws no response at all.

ISO 15765-2: the request is a single frame `03 22 <DID hi> <DID lo>` padded to 8 bytes with `0x55`; the response is a 54–63 byte data area delivered as a first frame plus 8–9 consecutive frames. **Flow control `30 00 00` (padded with `0xAA`) must be sent within a few milliseconds or the ECU abandons the transfer.**

UDS service `22` ReadDataByIdentifier. On this car the default session needs no handshake (no `10 03`, and certainly no `27`); `3E` tester-present was measured to be unnecessary (600 s of continuous sampling, zero errors). **Verified on this car only.**
Offsets in this document are into the data area **after stripping the `62 + DID` echo**; `[a:b]` excludes `b`; `value = raw × scale + add`. Big-endian unless the row says little.

budget: **These are tester-side observations, not ECU hard limits.** The often-quoted «VSA 80 ms» is the span from first frame to last frame, not an inter-frame gap, and it cannot be claimed as an STmin floor (the adapter used has no hardware timestamps).

**The serial model holds**: over 2,051 polling rounds the per-round identity `period = Σ(request→complete) + Σ(gaps)` has zero residual, with 1.48 ms of per-round overhead. That gives a **single-ECU serial ceiling of roughly 1 s / 30.5 ms ≈ 33 Hz (for the ECM)**. Cross-module concurrency is allowed by the protocol (one outstanding request per address) but was **never verified on this car**; summing per module and taking the maximum is only about 28% faster than strict serial, not the 10× some people expect.
For comparison: the tuning tool polls `22 2610` and `22 2611` at **18.13 Hz** each.

Two capture rules learned the hard way: ① a single timed-out request gets that address isolated, so put the most reliable DID first in a sampling group; ② **do not interleave a DID scan with continuous sampling on one serial chain while the car is moving** — a log that scanned while driving lost up to 7.891 s of continuous sampling in one gap, while a sampling-only log lost at most 1.244 s.

nrc.observed: the dominant negative response while scanning; by far the most common in the archive
service `21` (256 local identifiers across five modules) and service `24` both return it everywhere — unsupported on this car, not worth retrying
handled (up to 5 × timeout). Not counted as a negative response in the archive statistics

signals.name: ENGINE_RPM
signals.meaning_zh: 曲轴每分钟转数 (rpm)。怠速约 750, 红线 7000。原始值 ×0.25, FlashPro 逐点吻合, 置信度高。
signals.evidence: r = 0.99999984 against the tuning tool's RPM column
signals.source_report: independent re-derivation from the tuning tool's unrounded datalog export; session 5 (2026-09-12)

signals.name: MAP_ABS
signals.meaning_zh: 按raw/128得到kPa，产品增压使用同包MAP减BARO。round5完整行驶日志15976包，表压−77.5703125至+116.421875 kPa，正值占5.9339%。人工LogR−0.565 bar标记最近值−56.9140625 kPa；约+170 kPa仅为用户转述。保留数值研究依据，不宣称全量程独立标定。
signals.evidence: matches the tuning tool's MAP column; a 282 kPa absolute peak under full boost lines up with the in-car display reading 1.83 bar gauge
signals.source_report: independent re-derivation from the tuning tool's unrounded datalog export; session 5 (2026-09-12)

signals.name: ECT
signals.meaning_zh: 发动机水温 (°C), 原始值 −40。冷车 = 环境温度, 暖机后 80–95 °C, 风扇约 95+ 启动。置信度高。
signals.evidence: agrees item by item with the in-car coolant temperature display
signals.source_report: independent re-derivation from the tuning tool's unrounded datalog export; session 5 (2026-09-12)

signals.name: IAT
signals.meaning_zh: 进入发动机的空气温度 (°C, raw−40)。停车热浸后可 50+, 行驶中随中冷降到接近环境温度 +10。置信度高。
signals.evidence: matches the tuning tool's IAT column
signals.source_report: independent re-derivation from the tuning tool's unrounded datalog export; session 5 (2026-09-12)

signals.name: MAP_RELATED_B14
signals.meaning_zh: 第14字节保留历史拟合1.579×raw−19.76，不是整数kPa。round5报告含正压后最大残差约31 kPa，分析窗口未说明；不能当作16位MAP的替代，保持低置信度，不进入产品。
signals.evidence: not integer kPa and not linear over the full range; the fit coefficients change once positive boost is included, with up to ~31 kPa residual
signals.source_report: independent re-derivation from the tuning tool's unrounded datalog export; session 5 (2026-09-12)

signals.name: MAP_ALT_INT
signals.meaning_zh: 第 15 字节, ≈ 整数 kPa 的进气歧管压力 (与 16 位 MAP r=0.995)。是否同一标定未证明, 置信度中。
signals.evidence: a coarse MAP, r = 0.995 against the 16-bit one; saturates at 255 under high boost, so the 8-bit range is insufficient
signals.source_report: independent re-derivation from the tuning tool's unrounded datalog export; session 5 (2026-09-12)

signals.name: BARO
signals.meaning_zh: 环境气压 (kPa 整数)。海平面约 101, 两天两个天气值验证 (1006 hPa→100, 1009 hPa→101)。置信度中。
signals.evidence: two integer points on two days (1006 hPa→100, 1009 hPa→101); VSA `4005[21]` carries the same value
signals.source_report: independent re-derivation from the tuning tool's unrounded datalog export; session 5 (2026-09-12)

signals.name: VEHICLE_SPEED
signals.meaning_zh: ECU 侧车速 (km/h, 整数)。FlashPro CSV 用 mph, 斜率 0.621 正是 km/h→mph 换算。置信度高。
signals.evidence: verified 0–114 km/h; the 0.621 slope against the tool's mph column is exactly the unit conversion
signals.source_report: independent re-derivation from the tuning tool's unrounded datalog export; session 5 (2026-09-12)

signals.name: LOAD_ALT
signals.meaning_zh: 第 19 字节, 与 AIRC r=0.98, 可能是某种发动机负荷百分比, 性质待定。候选, 未最终验证, 置信度低。
signals.evidence: r = 0.98 against air charge, nature undetermined. It is currently the single best gating proxy for `2610[39]`, but very likely derives from the same internal load quantity, so it is not independent evidence
signals.source_report: independent re-derivation from the tuning tool's unrounded datalog export; session 5 (2026-09-12)

signals.name: IGN_ADVANCE
signals.meaning_zh: 火花塞在活塞到上止点前多少曲轴度数点火 (°)。怠速约 10°, 高转轻载 30°+, 爆震时 ECU 会推迟。raw×0.5−64, 置信度高。
signals.evidence: matches the tuning tool's ignition advance column
signals.source_report: independent re-derivation from the tuning tool's unrounded datalog export; session 5 (2026-09-12)

signals.name: BATTERY_V
signals.meaning_zh: ECU 供电电压 (V, raw×0.1)。熄火 12.x, 发动机运转发电机充电 13.5–14.5。置信度高。
signals.evidence: 96% of samples agree point for point with the tuning tool
signals.source_report: independent re-derivation from the tuning tool's unrounded datalog export; session 5 (2026-09-12)

signals.name: INJ_PULSE
signals.meaning_zh: 喷油器每次打开的时长 (ms, raw×0.001)。怠速 1–2 ms, 全油门可 10+ ms。置信度高。
signals.evidence: matches the tuning tool's injector pulse width column
signals.source_report: independent re-derivation from the tuning tool's unrounded datalog export; session 5 (2026-09-12)

signals.name: FUEL_PUMP_DUTY
signals.meaning_zh: 低压油泵通电百分比 (%, raw/9)。Codex 复核认为是占空比而非低压油压, 量纲存疑, 置信度中。
signals.evidence: stands in a 10/9 normalised relation to another channel, which looks more like a pump duty cycle than a low-side fuel pressure
signals.source_report: independent re-derivation from the tuning tool's unrounded datalog export; session 5 (2026-09-12)

signals.name: AC_REQUEST
signals.meaning_zh: 空调请求开关: 关=0x00, 开=0x03 (第 32 字节 bit0-1)。OBDb 记录的空调离合位是 bit6, 本车 bit6 恒为 0, 实际翻转位不同。置信度中。
signals.evidence: takes 0x00 / 0x01 / 0x03 in the archive: 0x01 with the key on and the engine off, 0x03 about 5 s after start. bit1 is exactly the bit the public signal set points at, **but nobody ever marked the A/C switch, so this stays a candidate**
signals.source_report: cross-check against public signal sets (2026-09-14); bit-order correction (2026-09-20)

signals.name: AIRFLOW
signals.meaning_zh: 空气流量计测得的进气质量流量 (g/s, raw×0.01)。怠速 3–5 g/s, 全油门 150+ g/s。与 AFM.c 公式吻合到 r=0.99996, 置信度高。
signals.evidence: r = 0.99996 against the relation AFM.c = 30000·AFM/RPM
signals.source_report: independent re-derivation from the tuning tool's unrounded datalog export; session 5 (2026-09-12)

signals.name: ECT2
signals.meaning_zh: 第38字节按raw−40°C研究显示。round5同一292秒文件中本量34→39、ECT58→79；连续变化但响应不同。不能据此确认传感器位置或否定另一冷却液测点，置信度低。
signals.evidence: r = 1.000 against the tuning tool's ECT2 column, yet within one 292 s file it moves 34→39 °C while coolant goes 58→79 °C — a location with far more thermal inertia
signals.source_report: independent re-derivation from the tuning tool's unrounded datalog export; session 5 (2026-09-12)

signals.name: BOOST_LOAD_STATE
signals.meaning_zh: 2610[39] 的 0/1/2 枚举。非零样本全部处于 MAP>=100 kPa, 对 boost>20 kPa 的召回率 96.2%; 状态 2 只见于高增压与近全开节气门。精确门限和迟滞未解, 置信度中。
signals.evidence: re-checked over the whole archive (31 logs, 53,908 samples, 180 state changes): every non-zero state has MAP_ABS ≥ 100.25 kPa. **A single pressure threshold and a Schmitt hysteresis are both refuted**; state 2 has only 8 independent entries, so its threshold is not identifiable
signals.source_report: candidate review (2026-09-18); full-archive re-check (2026-09-20)

signals.name: AIR_CHARGE_ALT
signals.meaning_zh: 第 40 字节, 与 FlashPro AIRC (相对气缸充气量) r=0.99 的 8 位版本。注意不是油压。置信度中。
signals.evidence: r = 0.99 against the tuning tool's air-charge column; an 8-bit version of it
signals.source_report: independent re-derivation from the tuning tool's unrounded datalog export; session 5 (2026-09-12)

signals.name: IAT2
signals.meaning_zh: 第 42 字节的第二个进气温度 (°C, raw−40), K20C1 涡轮前后各有温度传感器, 哪个在前未定。置信度高。
signals.evidence: matches the tuning tool's IAT2 column; the physical location is not inferred from the name
signals.source_report: independent re-derivation from the tuning tool's unrounded datalog export; session 5 (2026-09-12)

signals.name: OIL_PRESSURE_SENSOR_8BIT
signals.meaning_zh: 第43字节；round5零转速且16位油压为0时raw=38，带既有偏移的研究换算约0.498 kPa。不能把38直接当kPa，也未独立确认ADC电压范围。产品使用16位OIL_PRESSURE。
signals.evidence: r = 0.99995 against the 16-bit oil pressure, but **its zero is not zero** (raw = 38 at a true 0 kPa), so it cannot be used as a pressure directly
signals.source_report: independent re-derivation from the tuning tool's unrounded datalog export; session 5 (2026-09-12)

signals.name: OIL_PRESSURE
signals.meaning_zh: 研究值kPa，1 kPa/LSB。round5有2021个零转速/油压0的同包样本；人工LogR252 kPa的两组标记最近值为241和251 kPa，支持表压解释。仍缺压力参考面规格和独立标定，其他同包量有效不能排除本字段门控。实测58至621 kPa不定义健康报警阈值。
signals.evidence: 2,021 samples at zero engine speed read exactly 0 while the same responses carry BARO = 101 and MAP = 100.3, which rules out a dead sensor; idle readings of 241 / 251 against an in-car 252 support a gauge-pressure reading
signals.source_report: independent re-derivation from the tuning tool's unrounded datalog export; session 5 (2026-09-12)

signals.name: BATTERY_V_HIRES_CANDIDATE
signals.meaning_zh: 第 46-47 字节 /400 ≈ 电瓶电压, 但相关性只有 r=0.87 且变化范围仅 1.1 V。候选, 未最终验证, 置信度低。
signals.evidence: ≈ raw/400 resembles battery voltage, but r is only 0.87 and it moves over a span of just 1.1 V
signals.source_report: independent re-derivation from the tuning tool's unrounded datalog export; session 5 (2026-09-12)

signals.name: MAP_MMHG
signals.meaning_zh: 第 48-49 字节, 与 MAP r=0.994 的另一份进气压力, 假设单位 0.1 mmHg (×0.13332 = kPa)。单位是假设, 置信度中。
signals.evidence: r = 0.994 against MAP; the 0.1 mmHg/LSB unit is an **assumption**
signals.source_report: independent re-derivation from the tuning tool's unrounded datalog export; session 5 (2026-09-12)

signals.name: LAMBDA_ALT
signals.meaning_zh: 第 6-7 字节的另一份 λ (raw/32768), 与主 LAMBDA r=0.96, 可能是第二传感器或滤波值。置信度中。
signals.evidence: only ever moves within 0.997–1.016; possibly a second sensor or a filtered value
signals.source_report: independent re-derivation from the tuning tool's unrounded datalog export; session 5 (2026-09-12)

signals.name: LAMBDA
signals.meaning_zh: 实测空燃比 λ: 1.0 表示理论空燃比 14.7:1 (汽油), 小于 1 偏浓 (油多), 大于 1 偏稀。巡航≈1.0, 全油门 0.80–0.85 保护涡轮。raw/32768, 置信度高。
signals.evidence: AFR = λ × 14.7; the public signal set decodes the same bytes as ×29.4/65535 = AFR, which agrees
signals.source_report: independent re-derivation from the tuning tool's unrounded datalog export; session 5 (2026-09-12)

signals.name: SHORT_TRIM
signals.meaning_zh: 闭环根据氧传感器实时加减的喷油百分比 (%, raw×0.78125−100)。正常 ±5% 内, 正 = 加油。置信度高。
signals.evidence: exact coefficient 0.78125·raw − 100 recovered from unrounded values
signals.source_report: independent re-derivation from the tuning tool's unrounded datalog export; session 5 (2026-09-12)

signals.name: LONG_TRIM
signals.meaning_zh: ECU 长期学习的喷油偏移 (%)。长期偏离 ±10% 以上提示漏气或喷油器问题。置信度高。
signals.evidence: same encoding as short-term trim
signals.source_report: independent re-derivation from the tuning tool's unrounded datalog export; session 5 (2026-09-12)

signals.name: LAMBDA_CMD
signals.meaning_zh: ECU 想要达到的 λ 目标值 (同上编码)。与 LAMBDA 的差就是闭环修正在追的误差。置信度高。
signals.evidence: its difference from measured lambda is the error the closed loop is chasing
signals.source_report: independent re-derivation from the tuning tool's unrounded datalog export; session 5 (2026-09-12)

signals.name: FUEL_STATUS
signals.meaning_zh: 枚举值: 开环 (冷车/全油门, 不看氧传感器) 还是闭环 (按 λ 修正)。具体码值含义未整理。置信度高。
signals.evidence: only the values 2 and 4 have been observed
signals.source_report: independent re-derivation from the tuning tool's unrounded datalog export; session 5 (2026-09-12)

signals.name: PERCENT_UNKNOWN_B15
signals.meaning_zh: 第 15 字节 ×100/255, 与 FlashPro 内部第 21 通道 99.6% 一致但 CSV 未导出该列, 身份未知 (确定不是碳罐 Purge)。候选, 未最终验证, 置信度低。
signals.evidence: equals an internal channel of the tuning tool that its CSV export does not expose; identity unknown. **It is definitely not purge**
signals.source_report: independent re-derivation from the tuning tool's unrounded datalog export; session 5 (2026-09-12)

signals.name: CAM_CMD
signals.meaning_zh: VTC (可变气门正时) 的进气凸轮目标提前角 (°, 53−0.5·raw)。怠速≈0, 中转速可到 40°+。置信度高。
signals.evidence: corrected to 53 − 0.5·raw from unrounded values
signals.source_report: independent re-derivation from the tuning tool's unrounded datalog export; session 5 (2026-09-12)

signals.name: CAM
signals.meaning_zh: 进气凸轮实际提前角 (°, 同上编码)。与 CAM_CMD 的差反映 VTC 响应。置信度高。
signals.evidence: same encoding; its difference from the command shows the VTC response
signals.source_report: independent re-derivation from the tuning tool's unrounded datalog export; session 5 (2026-09-12)

signals.name: VTS
signals.meaning_zh: 高角度凸轮 (VTEC) 是否切换: 0=Off, 1=On (raw & 1)。K20C1 在中高转速大负荷时切换。置信度高。
signals.evidence: 0/2 = off, 1/3 = on (bit0)
signals.source_report: independent re-derivation from the tuning tool's unrounded datalog export; session 5 (2026-09-12)

signals.name: GEAR
signals.meaning_zh: ECU 由车速/转速比推算的档位: 0=空档或踩离合, 1–6 档; 倒档值未见。行驶验证 96% 与车速转速比一致 (换档瞬间除外)。置信度高。
signals.evidence: 96% agreement with the speed/rpm ratio while driving; 0 means neutral or clutch depressed. **The reverse value has never been seen** — selecting reverse still reads 0
signals.source_report: independent re-derivation from the tuning tool's unrounded datalog export; session 5 (2026-09-12)

signals.name: PEDAL
signals.meaning_zh: 驾驶员踩下油门踏板的百分比 (%, raw×0.005)。0 = 松开, 100 = 踩到底。置信度高。
signals.evidence: accelerator **pedal** position, distinct from throttle
signals.source_report: independent re-derivation from the tuning tool's unrounded datalog export; session 5 (2026-09-12)

signals.name: THROTTLE
signals.meaning_zh: 电子节气门实际开度 (%, raw×0.005)。不一定等于踏板: ECU 会限制或提前开。置信度高。
signals.evidence: actual electronic throttle position; it does not track the pedal one to one
signals.source_report: independent re-derivation from the tuning tool's unrounded datalog export; session 5 (2026-09-12)

signals.name: BOOST_PRESSURE
signals.meaning_zh: 节气门前 (涡轮出口/中冷后) 的绝对压力 (kPa, raw/76)。怠速≈大气压 101, 高负载与 MAP 重合, 最高见 202。涡轮表压 = 值−101.325。置信度高。
signals.evidence: pressure ahead of the throttle, different from MAP at idle; up to 202–215 kPa absolute while driving
signals.source_report: independent re-derivation from the tuning tool's unrounded datalog export; session 5 (2026-09-12)

signals.name: BOOST_CMD
signals.meaning_zh: ECU 的增压目标 (kPa 绝压, 同上编码)。与 BOOST_PRESSURE 差值即增压控制误差。置信度高。
signals.evidence: the target, same encoding
signals.source_report: independent re-derivation from the tuning tool's unrounded datalog export; session 5 (2026-09-12)

signals.name: WASTEGATE
signals.meaning_zh: 涡轮废气旁通阀 (wastegate) 实际行程 (raw×0.001, 单位疑似 mm, 0–8.5)。阀开得越大越多废气绕过涡轮, 增压越低。单位未证实, 置信度高 (相关性)。
signals.evidence: **signed**: of 42,797 samples, 41,971 are ≤9000 and 826 are ≥65000, with nothing in between; 34 adjacent-sample transitions cross the sign boundary and read as >30000 jumps unsigned but as zero jumps signed

signals.source_report: independent re-derivation from the tuning tool's unrounded datalog export; session 5 (2026-09-12)

signals.name: EXCAM

Matches the cluster point for point over 54→67 °C; the in-car display showed 54 °C where the bus read 55 °C; warm-up is continuous over 32→81 °C. **No precedent in any public source**; the model algorithm, the sensor arrangement and the start-up display threshold are all unverified

signals.name: BRAKE_HOLD_HOLDING_CANDIDATE

unidentifiable.options: 0.0045 (steering-angle / wheelbase kinematic model) vs 0.003924 (rear-wheel differential geometry)
unidentifiable.why: these are **not two independent calibrations**: the same geometric method yields 0.00347–0.00488 depending on the speed window and the track width used. The systematic error budget totals 43.4% (left/right asymmetry 34.1%, speed window 21.5%, trip-to-trip 16.0%), far larger than the 14.7% between the two candidates. Settling it needs an external yaw-rate reference (≥10 Hz, <3% error) or a measured track width and rolling circumference

unidentifiable.options: absolute vs gauge pressure as the input; a single threshold vs hysteresis vs a speed/gear-dependent split
unidentifiable.why: a single pressure threshold and a Schmitt hysteresis are both refuted (within one trip the state is entered at 7.1 kPa gauge and absent at 26.3 kPa, which would require the entry threshold to be below the exit threshold). Absolute vs gauge is not separable in this archive because barometric pressure only ever read 100 or 101. A speed/gear split improves held-out log-loss by 17–18%, short of the 20% bar but with a confidence interval crossing it → **undecided, not «no effect»**
over the observed range of −53…0 the two are identical, with zero counter-examples. One sample with magnitude above 127 would settle it
they are sign-extension pairs, so both readings give the same value over the observed range
they are independent channels, not mirrors; back-solving the yaw scale from each gives results 35% apart, so **at least one is wrong**, and there is no independent reference to say which

refuted.claim: Service 22 requests go to `7E0` and responses come from `7E8`
refuted.correction: this car uses 29-bit `18DA10F1` / `18DAF110`; Mode 01 on 11-bit `7DF` / `7E0` draws no response at all
refuted.mistake: a generic OBD-II prior applied to Honda's 29-bit diagnostic addressing

refuted.claim: `22 2610` does not answer, so a stock ECU must need a `10 03` + `27` handshake
refuted.correction: the tester's flow control was 120 ms late and the ECU abandoned the transfer; the default session needs no handshake
refuted.mistake: a rate limiter queued the flow control frame, and the resulting symptom was read as a protocol requirement

refuted.claim: Oil temperature is not in the ECU / the head unit gets it elsewhere
refuted.correction: it is in ECM `268F[15]`
refuted.mistake: only `2610` and `2611` had been searched before the negative conclusion was drawn

refuted.claim: 21 coefficients derived from the tuning tool (pedal 0.00457, cams, boost, air charge, an 8-bit wastegate, actual and commanded injection pressure swapped, torque in N·m …)
refuted.correction: all replaced by exact constants (0.005; 53 − 0.5·raw; raw/76 absolute; raw×3/128; a 16-bit wastegate; torque as 100·raw/255 %)
refuted.mistake: regressing against an already rounded and truncated CSV export, which also mixed inHg and psi
refuted.by: re-derivation from the unrounded datalog stream

refuted.claim: `2662[28] − 40` is a coolant temperature duplicate
refuted.correction: it stayed at 73 while coolant went 73→80 °C, so it was first downgraded to unknown and later identified as VTC duty (medium confidence)
refuted.mistake: a coincidence inside a short window read as a correspondence
refuted.by: self-review plus cross-check against public sources

refuted.claim: `2610[14]` is MAP in integer kPa
refuted.correction: not integer kPa and not linear over the full range; use `[9:11]`
refuted.mistake: a single linear fit over a narrow range

refuted.claim: `ECT2` is «coolant temperature 2»
refuted.correction: a location with far more thermal inertia; confidence dropped to low
refuted.mistake: a handful of samples, plus the continuous trace being misread as a frozen start-up snapshot

refuted.claim: Air charge can be used as OBD calculated load
refuted.correction: air charge is relative and reaches 218%; the semantics differ, and calculated load stays absent
refuted.mistake: conflating two different quantities because the units looked alike

refuted.claim: «The sum of ten transaction medians ≈ the cycle time, so the serial model holds»
refuted.correction: the method is wrong (medians do not add); the correct proof is a per-round identity with zero residual
refuted.mistake: a statistical error

refuted.claim: VSA has a fixed 80 ms consecutive-frame gap, and a 10/10/5 Hz schedule was built on it
refuted.correction: 80 ms is the first-frame-to-last-frame span; real CF gaps are ≈10 ms (VSA), ≈2 ms (ECM), ≈8 ms (EPS). That schedule would need 1700 ms of bus time per second from one module
refuted.mistake: reading a total duration as an inter-frame gap, and never checking the schedule against an ECU time budget

refuted.claim: «Everything on the in-car performance display except longitudinal G and clutch is readable»
refuted.correction: the steering scale is an assumption and the yaw rate is a model fit; neither is calibrated
refuted.mistake: over-generalisation

refuted.claim: With the key on and the engine not running, oil temperature reads 32 while the display shows dashes, so the product must reproduce that threshold
refuted.correction: that key-on capture never sampled `268F` at all, and by the time 32 was read the engine was turning at 1514 rpm
refuted.mistake: treating a verbal observation from a minute earlier and a current reading as the same instant

refuted.claim: «The low-pressure warning threshold must be below 58 kPa» and «above 4500 rpm the regulator is limiting pressure»
refuted.correction: 58 is merely the smallest value ever observed, and above 4500 rpm there are only 29 samples
refuted.mistake: an inference stated as a fact

refuted.claim: 0.0967 °/LSB for steering, with the full two-sided range reproduced
refuted.correction: the centre offset was not subtracted; it should be 0.0974, and that session never reached full right lock
refuted.mistake: a missing zero offset, plus a negative claim beyond the evidence

refuted.claim: `2611[55:56]` is a strong clutch candidate
refuted.correction: it is not the clutch, and it is not «a one-off adaptation right after start-up» either — one capture holds at least two non-zero stretches, the second lasting 80.3 s over 893 samples
refuted.mistake: first correlation mistaken for identification, then a «one-off» conclusion drawn from looking only at the start of the file

refuted.claim: The drive-mode bits are most likely concentrated in the damper module
refuted.correction: they are not in any of its 10 data DIDs; the mode bits are **spread across modules, each keeping its own**
refuted.mistake: assuming a single global flag
refuted.by: session 6, plus the owner explaining that the custom mode is six per-subsystem settings

refuted.claim: Scanning VSA `40xx` after parking returned zero responses, so the clutch is not in VSA
refuted.correction: the engine was already off and the ECU unpowered, so that scan proves nothing; the clutch is in VSA `4007[24]`
refuted.mistake: not verifying that the ECU was online before scanning — zero responses after shutdown are not exclusion evidence

refuted.claim: Longitudinal G is not in these nine VSA packets
refuted.mistake: it had only been correlated against brake pressure, never against acceleration, and no event-outlier analysis was done

refuted.claim: Live monitoring reported a boost peak of +0.85 bar
refuted.correction: computed over the full log it is +1.16 bar
refuted.mistake: polling misses instantaneous peaks; peak-type conclusions must always be computed from the complete log

refuted.claim: From the public archive: `7028` needs a −40 offset, `7022` is in miles, and the brake switch is bit7 of `4004[15]`
refuted.correction: on this car they read directly in °C, in km, and at bit0
refuted.mistake: a public table applied across model variants; the bit7 item was actually a bit-order conversion error (see the next row)

refuted.claim: «The public signal set's `bix` modulo 8 is the bit number within the byte»
refuted.correction: that project numbers bits **MSB0**: bit = 7 − (bix % 8). bix 262 is bit1 (not bit6) and bix 127 is bit0, so there was never a disagreement with this car
refuted.mistake: the original implementation was never opened; the convention was inferred backwards from one example that happened to fit
refuted.by: reading the upstream implementation at a fixed commit

refuted.claim: Service `21` might be the entry point to Honda's dealer-tool data list
refuted.correction: all 256 local identifiers on all five modules return `0x11` serviceNotSupported
refuted.mistake: extrapolating from older Honda platforms

refuted.claim: «`4007[9]` bit2 mirrors the brake switch; agreement rises to 100% as the time tolerance tightens, so the difference is sampling skew»
refuted.correction: the 97.05% figure reproduces, but «rises to 100%» is an artefact of which logs contribute (54 of the 58 pairs in the tightest bin come from logs where Hold was never enabled). bit2 is **not** an instantaneous mirror; what holds is «bit2 = pedal OR bit3»

refuted.claim: «Scanning the cluster / gateway / 0x70 at 5 ms intervals causes the link to stall» (stated as causation)
refuted.correction: the phenomenon is real and strongly correlated, but the **mechanism is not established**: «one ECU is busy» is ruled out and every other explanation is under-evidenced. Recorded as «strong correlation, mechanism unknown»
refuted.mistake: two reproductions written up as causation, with no graded evidence review

refuted.claim: «`48BD[21]` is not a mode byte — it takes the same three values in a capture with no mode changes»
refuted.correction: it **is** a candidate for tracking the drive mode: in one capture the confirmed mode byte runs 1→2→3→1 across four segments while `48BD[21]` runs 0x10→0x20→0x30→0x10 in step, with the boundaries aligned to within one polling interval; a separate capture with no mode changes holds 0x10 for all 176 samples
refuted.mistake: the «no-change control» never checked whether that control capture contained a mode change, and no per-segment alignment was done — the value sets merely looked alike

refuted.claim: «`268F[39]` is a high-load flag»
refuted.correction: that byte is 0 in all 20,684 samples in the archive; there is nothing to stand on. Probably a mix-up with `2610[39]`
refuted.mistake: two similar offsets in two different DIDs confused in a note, with no return to the raw samples

refuted.claim: «`268F[40]/[42]/[44]/[46]` are four identical switches that set once coolant reaches 80 °C»
refuted.correction: they are **two pairs** of bit fields (bit0 / bit2), not four copies; the value set {0,1,4} is all powers of two. The coolant threshold is refuted by counter-example (whole captures sit above 80 °C with the bytes at 0)
refuted.mistake: a value set of {0,1} assumed to mean a switch, without testing whether the four bytes are equal sample by sample

refuted.claim: «`10:3004` looks like a date/time or a mileage-segmented record»
refuted.correction: counter, BCD date, mileage/service structure and freeze frame are **all refuted** (all 70 width × endianness combinations show non-wrapping decreases; 20 of 70 produce illegal BCD and change in both directions within 1.4 s; subsets independently confirmed stationary by vehicle speed still show many distinct payloads)
refuted.mistake: a guess written from a few non-zero bytes in the first reading that happened to look like a date, with no width / endianness / BCD enumeration and no check of whether it is constant at rest

refuted.claim: «The first 6 bytes of an ECM response are a general bitmap over the remaining 48»
refuted.correction: the general model is **refuted**: 9 of the 58 DIDs that meet the length condition provide counter-examples. It holds on the 29 DIDs where the test has discriminating power, while 17 «zero counter-examples but no discriminating power» cases do not count as support. Among same-numbered pairs only 4 of 7 hold → «some members of a family share a header», not a family-wide bitmap
refuted.mistake: counting non-discriminating samples as positives

refuted.claim: `WASTEGATE` decodes as unsigned 16-bit (giving a maximum of 65.532 in the statistics)
refuted.correction: it is signed. Of 42,797 samples, 41,971 are ≤9000 and 826 are ≥65000 with nothing in between; the most negative value, −176, matches the tuning tool's over-travel
refuted.mistake: the note had said for a long time that the real range includes negatives, but the decode flag never followed, and nobody questioned a physically impossible maximum sitting in the statistics

refuted.claim: An analysis script took wheel speed from `48C4[0:8]`
refuted.correction: the mapping is at `[23:31]`. `[0:8]` is constant at `0000FFFFFFC00000` throughout the archive, which yields a fixed 327.52 km/h with zero derivative (a silent miss, never a false positive)
refuted.mistake: the offset of a reference quantity was hard-coded in an analysis script instead of being read from the decode table
refuted.by: per-log re-check over the whole archive (2026-09-19)

text: **Essentially none.** There is a gateway behind this car's OBD-II connector, and no periodic vehicle CAN frames reach it with the key on, at idle or while driving. That is why everything in this document comes from active polling.

The only repeating frame in the archive that is not part of a request/response exchange appeared while passively recording a tuning tool session: **11-bit ID `0x784`, data `01 00 7E 6A 00 00 00 00`, roughly every 2.51 s**. Neither its sender nor its meaning is established — the tuning tool was on the bus at the time, so it cannot be ruled out as the source. No decoding is offered for it.
Two unusual diagnostic addresses were also seen: the functional broadcast `18DBEFF1` once, and `18DAF1EF` twice. Those are still request/response traffic, not vehicle broadcasts.

If what you want is chassis broadcast data (the kind covered by openpilot's `opendbc`), you have to tap the powertrain bus **inside** the gateway — the candidate points are the 12-pin front camera connector or the 32-pin cluster connector A. This project has **never** done that, so it offers no conclusions about that bus.

limits.text: every conclusion comes from the same FL5 with a Hondata FlashPro fitted. Whether a stock car's default session behaves the same, and whether `268F` answers at all, **has never been tested**.

the reference plane for oil pressure (gauge or absolute), the yaw and lateral-G scales, the °/LSB of the steering angle and the wastegate unit are all uncalibrated. The scale factors here are research fits, not calibrations.

the research polled far more slowly than the tuning tool's 18 Hz (most extended quantities at 0.2–1.2 Hz). Sub-second transients and fast counters alias at that rate — which is exactly why the counter test on the damper module's live packet could only be recorded as «insufficient».
VSA `A083–FFFF`, EPS `2A31–FFFF`, everything outside `7000–70FF` on the cluster, the gateway pair `ED`/`EF`, `0x70` and the Honda Sensing sub-units were never scanned.

limits.item: No data for cold or extreme conditions
limits.text: negative ambient temperatures can never be verified where this car is driven, and a single continuous cold-start-to-thermal-equilibrium recording is still missing.

limits.item: What is still missing (no special driving required — ordinary commuting covers it)
limits.text: ① state 2 of `2610[39]` needs ≥10 independent high-boost events sampled at ≤0.1 s; ② separating absolute from gauge pressure needs a trip at a noticeably different barometric pressure; ③ the `268F` latch needs ≥10 set events; ④ the `2611` tail needs one sample with magnitude above 127 to fix its width; ⑤ Brake Hold needs ≥20 stops with pedal evidence at a matching rate; ⑥ the «constant» DIDs need one read each across several natural ignition cycles.

an external yaw-rate reference (≥10 Hz, <3% error), a measured track width and rolling circumference, an independent lateral-G calibration, and independent ground truth for `3004` (service records, cluster readings or manufacturer documentation). Service `24` (read scaling data) returned `0x11` twice, so that route is closed.
